decision_rule: Run Arabis inference only if the frozen ensemble passes every simulation-only gate. Report the result regardless of its sign and do not choose members from Arabis correlation.

conditioning.n_haplotypes: the exact number of simulated haploid genomes, stored explicitly in every shard

frozen_checkpoint_selection: maximum pooled simulated validation Pearson within each seed

population_structure_prior.diffuse_island_demes: uniform integer from 2 through min(5,n), with a Dirichlet-multinomial allocation and at least one haplotype per deme

recombination_target.definition: coalescent-effective rate r_eff = r_meiotic * (1-F), where F=selfing/(2-selfing)
recombination_target.interpretive_constraint: For spatially constant selfing this is a chromosome-wide scalar and cannot by itself rescue or destroy chromosome-relative map-shape correlation.

simulation_tractability.method: reduce census and effective Ne for draws above the cap while retaining the drawn meiotic map
